subject: Request: POC window + sandbox top-up due to integration blocker
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@papertraillabs.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Renee Ortiz <renee.o@papertraillabs.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC with Redwood — hitting SSO mapping errors, need short extension + sandbox credits

Hi Lauren,

We're into week two of the PoC and hit a blocker during SSO verification. Auth requests intermittently 401 during our end-to-end smoke tests — looks like a SAML attribute mapping issue between our IdP and Redwood's redirect handler. Our eng lead is on it but the fix depends on a small infra change that's queued behind a heavier sprint work this week.

Because of this, our QA window will slip ~10 business days. Can you help with two things so we don't lose momentum:
 - A 14-day extension on the PoC window (we're currently scheduled to wrap Aug 14)
 - A short sandbox top-up (~50k tokens) so our team can continue exploratory flows once we re-run verification

I've attached a short auth excerpt and a screenshot of the error. If you need any more logs or a quick walk-through, Renee can schedule time with our SRE.

Appreciate any help — we like where this is going and want to avoid a hard stop.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Engineering, PaperTrail Labs
(samir.k@papertraillabs.com)

Attachments: auth-error.log (snippet), screenshot-auth-401.png

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@papertraillabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — hitting SSO mapping errors, need short extension + sandbox credits

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and for attaching the log excerpt.

Short answer: yes, we can help. I'll coordinate with product and engineering to expedite a short-term top-up and the extension while we work through the SAML mapping. Marissa — looping you in to confirm commercial approval for a 14-day extension and a sandbox credit bump. Dev (Vik) — Samir included an auth snippet; can you triage the likely cause and confirm if a temporary config mapping will unblock them?

Samir, can Renee share a fuller trace (with request IDs) and the IdP metadata? That will speed triage. I've attached a quick mutual action plan draft that shows the timetable we'd propose for extension + deliverables.

I'll follow up once I have engineering's recommendation (hopefully within the day) and confirmation from Marissa on credits.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC with Redwood — hitting SSO mapping errors, need short extension + sandbox credits

Lauren / Marissa — looked at the snippet Samir sent. Preliminary read: the 401s line up with a missing or malformed SAML attribute "email" vs "userPrincipalName" that our redirect handler expects. Two options to unblock quickly:

1) Short-term workaround: Add an attribute mapping at the IdP side to surface the expected attribute name (Samir's team). This is the fastest (minutes) and doesn't require a code change.
2) If mapping can't be changed, we can deploy a tiny shim in the staging redirect that translates attributes — ~2–4 hour patch and config rollout.

If Samir can share the full request IDs and IdP metadata, I can confirm which path is simpler. I've attached a short stacktrace we capture when the request fails — it shows the missing attribute case.

I'll stand by for the log dump and can pair with their SRE on a screenshare.

—Vik (Dev oncall)
Attachments: connector-stacktrace-20260803.txt

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@papertraillabs.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Renee Ortiz <renee.o@papertraillabs.com>, Ava Consulting <infra+ava@aconsult.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — hitting SSO mapping errors, need short extension + sandbox credits

Thanks Vik — appreciate the quick read. We've pulled the full trace and IdP metadata and attached auth-error.log with the request IDs you asked for. Renee says their IdP team can flip the attribute mapping if that's the cleanest path; we'll try that today and let you know.

On the credits/extension: we would very much appreciate the top-up now if possible so QA can continue once we confirm the mapping change. The team is free for a short call today afternoon to walk through the trace.

Samir

Attachment: auth-error.log

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@papertraillabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — hitting SSO mapping errors, need short extension + sandbox credits

Samir — quick update from our side:

- Engineering confirms the IdP attribute mapping is the fastest unblock (option 1). If your IdP team flips the mapping and shares a quick verification session we'll validate and close the loop.
- Commercial: Marissa approved a 14-calendar-day extension and a one-time sandbox credit bump of 60k tokens to cover re-runs (we decided slightly higher than requested to be safe).
- I've attached the signed trial-extension approval PDF; this will be recorded against PTL-2026-0893 and reflected in your sandbox account within the hour.

If anything proves different once you flip the mapping, we'll fall back to the small shim patch; Vik is on standby to push it through. Let me know when you'd like the verification session (we can do 2pm PT today).

Thanks for moving fast on your side. Looking forward to wrapping a successful PoC.

Best,
Lauren
Attachment: trial-extension-approval-20260803.pdf
